[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This is a mod for those who find the fish in the game a bit boring or uninspiring. The fish mostly follow the silhouettes of the fish already in the game so they feel familiar at a glance. There are a few exceptions to that when I felt it would hinder the point of this mod. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]All the fish follow my own design philosophies when it comes to pixel art, adding more color pop and contrast, along with some visual flair. [/size][/color]

[i][color=#00ff00][font=Courier New]PS: If you're enjoying the mod, leaving an endorsement really helps others find it! [/font][/color][/i]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure Content Patcher is installed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- 71 unique sprites changed
- Improved visual clarity
- More pop and color
- Interesting designs
- Silhouettes remain mostly similar to original sprites

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- SMAPI
- Content Patcher[/size][/color]
